rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a Day 5 expanded 3AA blastocyst, including expanded blastocoel, thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE. It is detailed, though some image-specific claims such as exact ICM clock position and metabolic interpretation go beyond what can be confidently verified from a single image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte maturity, male factor diagnosis, sperm motility, endometrial thickness, BMI, and first-cycle status well, and links these factors to prognosis and transfer strategy.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to embryo quality and patient factors. Minor issues include somewhat confident claims about euploidy likelihood and cumulative/live birth framing from a single transfer.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, especially support for eSET in a good-prognosis 35-year-old with a high-quality blastocyst. Small deviations include overstatement of ERA/DFI/PGT-A considerations and some non-guideline lifestyle claims.
Provides clear, practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, post-failure workup, and future planning, with appropriate distinctions between what is indicated now versus after repeated failure.
